title: Case 031: June statement in the secure portal
initial_request: I own my H&V account and need my June 2025 statement, but I cannot find it in the secure portal. Please make the statement available there.
overview: Elowen Marr escalated through secure chat after reporting that her June 2025 statement was missing from the secure portal. The statements service checked the period and placed statement HV-031 in her portal. H&V notified her that it is available to download; she has not said whether she downloaded it.

next_action.summary: Ask the statements service to check the June 2025 period and place the available statement in the account owner's secure portal.

outcome: The June 2025 statement, file statement-031.pdf, is available for download in Elowen Marr's secure portal. Downloading it is not confirmed.

events.body: I own this account and need my June 2025 statement for my monthly records, but I cannot find it in the secure portal. Please help me access the statement there.
I’m escalating this because I still can’t find my June statement in the portal. I need the statement itself made available there; I’m not asking for it by email.
I’m asking you to check the June 2025 statement period for the account owner and place the available document in her secure portal. Case reference HV-031.
Statement HV-031 for June 2025 has been placed in the account owner's secure portal as statement-031.pdf. The displayed statement shows an opening balance of £410.00 and a closing balance of £386.00.
Your June 2025 statement, statement-031.pdf, is available to download in your secure portal. It has not been sent by email.
